Subject: MAP kickoff: sequencing & fallback plan for MSA/DPA/orderform (BioCare)

Team,

Quick kickoff note — BioCare is asking for a compact mutual action plan that shows how we will sequence MSA, DPA, and order form sign-offs alongside the pilot acceptance window. Their procurement lead called out two constraints: (1) legal redlines can take 7–10 business days internally and (2) their security/compliance team needs SOC2 evidence before DPA signature.

Attached is the working MAP_v2.xlsx with our suggested lanes. Key asks:
- Kimberly: can you confirm which MSA redlines are deal blockers vs. commercial asks? I pasted a short list in the spreadsheet.
- Jonas: can you propose a fallback model we can serve (lighter SLA) if dedicated capacity timing slips? We want explicit fallback language for the order form to avoid a sign/ship delay.
- Hannah: procurement cadence and DocuSign / procurement team contacts — please add earliest possible dates for PO issuance.

Target close: we told BioCare we can execute signature + pilot onboarding in the 3-week window after redlines are cleared. I want to be explicit about sequences and contingency paths so procurement knows where to escalate.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP lanes + dates), MSA_redlines_v3.pdf (initial redline set).

Thanks — will set a 30m sync after comments come in.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0192

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@biocare.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: sequencing & fallback plan for MSA/DPA/orderform (BioCare)

Thanks Priyom — quick readthrough and notes.

High level: the majority of redlines in MSA_redlines_v3.pdf are standard commercial tweaks. Only two items look like legal blockers for acceptance:
1) Data residency clause (BioCare asked to restrict to regionally‑segregated storage) — this is negotiable but will require alignment with Private/VPC options if they insist.
2) Indemnity cap language — their counsel marked higher than our standard.

If both are non-starters for BioCare, we can propose a carve-out in the DPA for the SOC2 evidence path and put a conditional acceptance clause in the order form (pilot acceptance subject to SOC2 review). That gets signatures moving while compliance completes evidence review.

On sequencing: propose the following condensed lanes in the MAP spreadsheet (I've added comments):
- Day 0: MSA commercial redline resolution (legal + AM)
- Day 1–5: DPA review in parallel (but DPA signature contingent on SOC2 acceptance)
- Day 3–7: Order form finalization and DocuSign send (order form includes conditional acceptance clause)

Please note: if BioCare requires regional-only hosting and wants Private deployment, we will need a 2–3 week lead time for infra onboarding. Jonas — flag if that changes the fallback.

Attachments: I uploaded annotated MSA_redlines_v3.pdf (comments).

Kimberly Park
Head of Contract Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@biocare.com>

Cc: BioCare Procurement <procurement@biocare.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: sequencing & fallback plan for MSA/DPA/orderform (BioCare)

Priyom / Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan and the annotated redlines. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can accept a conditional clause for DPA signoff as long as SOC2 evidence is submitted within 10 business days of signature.
- Data residency: our security team prefers regional isolation, but they can accept a hybrid approach for pilot if we provide an SLA for segregation and a timeline to migrate if needed.
- Procurement window: we aim to issue a PO in week of May 25th, but that depends on MSA redline resolution by May 18th.

I shared the MAP spreadsheet with our procurement lead and created a DocuSign envelope for the order form so we can move quickly once redlines are in. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF123456

If you can confirm the conditional DPA language and fallback order form wording by Wednesday EOD (May 13), we will try to align our internal legal review to meet May 18 target.

Regards,
Sarah Lee
Senior Procurement Manager | BioCare Therapeutics
sarah.lee@biocare.com
Procurement: procurement@biocare.com

Appreciate the quick responses and Sarah — thanks for the DocuSign link and clarity on dates. Summary / next actions (I updated the MAP_v2.xlsx lanes accordingly):

1) Kimberly to deliver annotated conditional DPA wording + suggested conditional order form paragraph (due: Wed 2026-05-13 EOD).
2) Jonas to prepare fallback order form template (reduced SLA / provisional capacity) and indicate expected infra lead time if Private deployment required (due: Wed 2026-05-13).
3) Hannah to confirm procurement contact and earliest PO issuance cadence and add HubSpot timeline. (Hannah — please paste procurement contact and PO cadence in the MAP).
4) Sarah / BioCare: will aim to route legal internally to meet May 18 MSA resolution target; procurement aiming for week of May 25 PO.

I created the HubSpot deal and linked it here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765 (deal ID RWI-2209-BIO). Once we have Kimberly's conditional language, I'll route the DocuSign envelope and request countersignature.

If there are any escalation items (e.g., regional hosting is a hard requirement) call out immediately — that will change timeline. Planning a 30m sync Fri 2026-05-14 09:00 PT to confirm lanes — please accept calendar invite if available.

Thanks all — moving to action items.
